title: RT-qPCR for Primary Cells
author: Shiyi Wang
materials: Plate cDNA samples on a 96-well qPCR plate.
Normalize Ct values to the housekeeping gene 18S.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a reaction mix for each well containing the following components:

substeps.instruction: Add 5 μL Fast SYBR Green Master Mix
Add 4 μL cDNA sample (diluted to 12.5 ng/μL)

steps.title: Load qPCR plate
steps.instruction: Dispense the prepared reaction mix into a 96-well qPCR plate according to the following requirements:

substeps.instruction: Include two to four technical replicates for each sample
Include a no-cDNA control (negative control) containing all components except cDNA to check for contamination

steps.title: Record results
steps.instruction: Record the cycle threshold (Ct) values for each well.
